new_items.content: Indexed standing-pure view over the 74 source-local layer purpose statements. The purposes remain distinguishable by parse-unit ID and source layer while being grouped into foundation/restoration, hypothesis/experiment, AGI/alignment, representation/causal, universal/formal, empirical-validation and engineering/terminal families. No purpose is replaced by repository-level mission alone.

Indexed standing-pure view over specialized source-local definitions beyond the core ontology, including AGI criteria, causal-identification variables, field/thermodynamic objects, later depth hierarchies, bottleneck/metric objects, representation geometry, causal velocity/mass quantities, truth-coupling variables and formal validation states. Semantic identity across repeated tokens is NOT_ESTABLISHED unless separately recorded.

Indexed standing-pure view over layer-level status/qualifier statements: axiom provisionality, theory/proposal standing, absence of execution/results, source-relative scope, and other qualifiers. It reports what a source says its object is; it does not merge the status statement into the object it qualifies.

Standing-pure conceptual assertions that motivate, constrain or interpret architectures/definitions without themselves being architecture proposals or definitions. Branches include restoration principles, ontology/axiom non-inferences, alignment/control principles, memory/anchor principles, safety/failure-mode assertions, conservation cautions and operating-system claims.

Standing-pure explicit hypothesis view for specialized branches such as substrate independence, conservation-like causal-mass behavior, thermodynamic/resource constraints and truth-alignment/reality-coupling hypotheses. These remain hypotheses regardless of universal/conservation/thermodynamic rhetoric.

Standing-pure source-level synthesis/interpretation statements from layers describing unified, complete or final conceptual views. This preserves the conceptual content separately from both formal equations and source-status/supersession labels.
